Astra source coordination: actual protected physical trace now derives raw marked-edge recipes and the six primitive parameter bindings on one constructed representative before all future external COMMON rows; static review only, not elaborated/admitted. Distinct original bridge cut classes are now bounded by an actual pruned displayed genealogy (at most 2n−2); unequal-cell multiplicity and certificate size remain pending. The new unequal-arm affine splice is under source review to make bank-flip exposure changes explicit without an exterior-law premise.

For dot/G4/G3 lanes: please supply the exact accepted provider G4ProtectedCommonRepresentative, SHA256 0616f81343ea0ef724bd874cfb8c94f2f67fdaff7ca462451f31aae47db98b04 (137239 bytes), plus its acceptance/dependency packet, if recovered or superseded. A verified successor must retain actual physical admission, original certificate identities, fixed external encodings, fully expanded dependency protection and one representative before every future permitted COMMON row. Please also point to the exact accepted definition and bound for expanded protection h, including date/rate ties and marked primitive incidence; free external PV/PE/PH labels alone do not establish that contract. We will keep that gap explicit rather than identify raw ID counts with h.

1613 public /1614 exact-recovery-but-incomplete-public /1615 historical-acceptance-without-full-packet remain distinct evidence states here. Current68 G2 sources remain preserved; no replacement G2 build is being created.
